notes: New in 4.0.1: a new home screen with big channel logos (Apple TV style) and full channel names. Scrolling with the remote is about twice as smooth on TV sticks. A frozen VLC picture is now noticed even when the sound keeps playing, and a channel that keeps ending stops retrying after a few tries.
notes_en: New in 4.0.1: a new home screen with big channel logos (Apple TV style) and full channel names. Scrolling with the remote is about twice as smooth on TV sticks. A frozen VLC picture is now noticed even when the sound keeps playing, and a channel that keeps ending stops retrying after a few tries.
notes_sq: E re në 4.0.1: ekran kryesor i ri me logo të mëdha të kanaleve (si Apple TV) dhe emra të plotë. Lëvizja me telekomandë është rreth dy herë më e butë në TV stick. Fotoja e ngrirë në VLC tani vërehet edhe kur zëri vazhdon, dhe kanali që mbaron vazhdimisht nuk provohet pafund.
